topic: How to Remove Ink Stains From Clothes
notes: Use stain-removal guidance only for washable fabrics and keep the garment care label as the controlling instruction. Different inks and fabrics behave differently, so do not promise complete removal. Avoid universal solvent advice beyond what the source supports, and recommend testing any treatment on an inconspicuous area when compatibility is uncertain.

sources.title: Clothes Captioning: Complying with the Care Labeling Rule
